title: Appeal requirements
text:
19.45.020 Appeal requirements.
A.	Who May Appeal. The applicant may appeal a final decision on an application to the appellate authority designated by this article, if any.
B.	Form of Appeal. The appeal shall contain a written statement of the reasons why the final decision is erroneous, and shall be accompanied by the fee established by the city council. An appeal by an applicant shall be accompanied by a copy of the application on which the initial decision was rendered. An appeal may include any other documents that support the position of the appellant.
C.	Time for Filing Appeal. A written appeal must be submitted to the responsible official within ten business days from the date of notification of the final decision on the application.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
